entries.name: Opium Barcelona
entries.physical_address: Passeig Marítim de la Barceloneta, 34, 08003 Barcelona
entries.acquisition_path_detail: The Fourvenues ticketing platform's own public, unauthenticated events API (https://api.fourvenues.com/no-auth/events?slug=opium-barcelona) — reusable ingestion/fourvenues/ family. Proven live in research/source-investigations/opium-barcelona-01/. This package always passes an explicit forward-only [now, now+2 years] window (never the platform's own undocumented default window) to reach the source's genuine future horizon deterministically, without accidentally including already-past events (an earlier exploratory query that mistakenly included roughly a year of PAST dates returned many more records — corrected in this package's actual collector).
entries.rights_notes: Not reviewed for reuse permission in this package.
entries.research_notes: 97 genuinely upcoming records observed live with an explicit forward-only 2-year window at proof time.

research_provenance.note: Technical acquisition path directly proven live under research/source-investigations/opium-barcelona-01/.

entries.name: La Paloma
entries.acquisition_path_detail: A bespoke, first-party, undocumented WordPress admin-ajax action (`action=event_controller`, POST to /wp-admin/admin-ajax.php with mes/any/categoria/lang params) returning a flat JSON array of upcoming events, queried one calendar month at a time. Dates are Catalan natural-language text (e.g. 'divendres 4 de setembre de 2026 a les 23:59'), parsed deterministically via a fixed Catalan day/month-name table. Proven live in research/source-investigations/la-paloma-barcelona-01/.
entries.rights_notes: Not reviewed for reuse permission in this package.
entries.research_notes: 21 upcoming records observed live for a single queried month (September 2026) at proof time.

entries.name: Sant Jordi Club
entries.acquisition_path_detail: The events listing page contains real, directly-crawlable /en/{slug} links; each individual event page embeds its facts (address, startDate, title) as literal JavaScript variable assignments in the static HTML (not a rendered JSON-LD block) — extracted via a small, bounded, deterministic regex. Shares the same feed as the main Palau Sant Jordi arena and Estadi Olímpic; only records whose own `address` variable equals exactly "Sant Jordi Club" are retained.
